recent.text: Trendon Watford on Karlo Matkovic clear confidence shooting 3s (he started 4/4 vs. Min): "We encourage him, too. It's obviously him putting the work in and feeling comfortable doing it, but once you've got the locker room encouraging you to shoot, you feel even better about it."

recent.text: Trendon Watford (12 pts, 6 reb in 19 min) after being asked about his big 3Q: "I think we just needed a spark. Our energy was a little down. Subbed in at (small-ball center), I wanted to play with some energy and use my speed, try to make something happen."

recent.text: In a third straight intense West matchup this week, #Pelicans play Timberwolves evenly, before Minnesota pulls away in fourth quarter for 115-109 #NBA Cup victory. Jeremiah Fears tops New Orleans with 24 pts. Postgame wrap: https://t.co/6GP5xtAuUG https://t.co/deyJGygfme
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: More good minutes from Watford (7 pts, 5 reb in 14 min). He described himself as "slow" yesterday but he gets past Minnesota on end-to-end drive here
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Just like in Wednesday's game, Zion Williamson had a quiet first half (2 pts tonight), but the offense is starting to run through him and Wolves have their hands full trying to stop his drives. Zion now 13 pts, 6 reb mid 3Q
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Update: He has 16 pts with 3:40 still left in the quarter, after hitting another trey. Confidence through the roof
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer
recent.quoted_text: Slow start for #Pelicans but Mr. Matkovic will have something to say about that. On fire from three-point range (making three straight) plus a fast-break alley oop dunk and he has 11 rapid pts
